The residual development failures comprise seven no-first-reach episodes and three reach-then-interrupt episodes. request.current_synthesis: Observed: M8 verified that T2's construction sampled the full 0.06-0.20 m radius range while preserving the official 0.06-0.20 m default, 10-frame action timing, 100-step hold requirement, and interruption reset. T2 was a fresh 120832-step PPO artifact whose training proxy only nominated checkpoints. M9 evaluated T2 and T1 on identical 160 seeds and semantics: T2 achieved 150/160 and T1 105/160, with 48 T2 wins versus 3 T1 wins. M14 and M15 measured all ten T2 failure seeds plus ten geometry-matched controls with time-resolved joint state, endpoint state and velocity, distance, action/torque, hold transitions, bounded IK/branch diagnostics, and contacts; M15 independently verified 20 rollouts and 6119 steps. Six negative-angle no-first-reach failures enter the compiled +/-170-degree joint-limit region with persistent saturated torque and high velocity, one approximately -32-degree no-reach failure shows sustained high-speed saturated oscillation, and the three reach-then-interrupt failures leave tolerance after only 1, 3, and 3 observed held steps while velocity and saturated or near-saturated torque remain high. Forward qpos/qvel replay preserves the seven no-first-reach and three reach-then-interrupt classes. All 6119 samples have zero contacts, and final branch feasibility/occupancy does not separate failures from matched controls, so branch/contact intervention is not supported. Correction to the inherited direction: the 5.918 mm position discrepancy, 0.158 m/s velocity discrepancy, and 56 tolerance disagreements are an unresolved measurement/endpoint-semantic limitation; they must be quantified and preserved rather than silently treated as synchronized physical state or as a reason to alter official semantics. The evidence supports testing a targeted acquisition/braking and post-reach regulation intervention, but it does not establish that radius exposure alone caused T2's improvement, prove a unique singularity cause, establish branch/contact causality, or establish the 98% objective.
request.decision_frontier: The active bounded distinction is whether targeted acquisition/braking and post-reach regulation can materially improve complete-policy capability toward 196/200, versus whether the intervention fails or cannot be interpreted because endpoint-cache/live-environment semantics obscure exact hold timing. The discriminating evidence is one bounded implementation and complete-candidate comparison against T2 on identical held-out seeds, preserving official target sampling, 10-frame action timing, reset, 100-step hold, and success semantics, with time-resolved acquisition, joint/endpoint velocity, distance, action/torque, hold transitions, and live-versus-forward-reference discrepancy. Improvement in the residual failure classes would justify retaining targeted policy development; no improvement would constrain this recipe-specific intervention and support a different policy direction; unresolved semantic disagreement would require carrying the limitation rather than claiming a mechanism result. M15's zero-contact panel and non-separating branch diagnostics make branch/contact targeting unsupported unless new evidence changes that result.
request.human_goal_connection: The human goal remains a learned policy achieving at least 196 successes in the protected 200-episode assessment, where each success is an uninterrupted 100-control-step hold within 1 cm. T2:checkpoint-120832 is the strongest complete development candidate at 150/160 (93.75%) on M9, but this is not official certification. M15 makes a bounded targeted intervention scientifically worthwhile by identifying actionable acquisition/braking and post-reach regulation signatures in the ten residual T2 failures.
request.next_direction_or_closure: Goal review declines official assessment because the best-known candidate is 150/160 on development evidence, below the 196/200 objective, with ten structured residual failures and unresolved exact timing semantics. I4 is opened with a positive but bounded targeted direction: implement and evaluate one acquisition/braking and post-reach regulation intervention under preserved official semantics, explicitly recording the endpoint discrepancy. The inquiry closes only after the complete-candidate comparison establishes meaningful capability improvement, a negative/inconclusive targeted result, or a semantic limitation that prevents a trustworthy comparison; none of those outcomes alone certifies the human goal.
